title: Panacea: Mitigating Harmful Fine-tuning for Large Language Models via Post-fine-tuning Perturbation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical defense mechanism (Panacea) using weight perturbations to maintain safety alignment in Large Language Models. While it evaluates safety—which includes illegal and harmful behaviors—it does so using established technical benchmarks (like AdvBench) and does not specifically engage in evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical systems.
